question: To mark the celebration of Gandhi Jayanti, the _____________ celebrates it as International Day of Non-Violence.

options.text: South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation

solution:
The correct answer is __**United Nations**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **United Nations** celebrates **Gandhi Jayanti** as the **International Day of Non-Violence**.
 
• The International Day of Non-Violence is observed on **2nd October**, the **birthday of Mahatma Gandhi**.
